title: Internet access where unengaged people groups live
caveat: NATIONAL figures (World Bank). Per-city connectivity is not publicly available — do not read a city off a country.

sheet.ai: Data was found by AI deep research — it is subject to false information.
sheet.note: National figures, not city measurements. Carrier names are ASN registry holders — that set includes banks and universities as well as ISPs, so the carrier flag is a name heuristic, not a verified classification.

list.title: Cities with Internet
list.intro: Connectivity where the unengaged people groups live. Every figure is a measured national statistic with its observation year —
list.source: Internet and mobile figures: World Bank Open Data (CC BY 4.0), most recent observation 2018–2024. Banding: connected ≥60% · partial 25–59% · low <25% of population using the internet. Country-resolution: per-city measurements are not publicly available at this scale. ISP names, carrier names and censorship history require per-country cited reporting and are not shown.
